item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Meher looks at the diagram. It shows the front, top, and side views of one solid.

Which claim correctly decides how to identify the solid from those views?

options.A: Use the front, top, and side views together; one projection alone is not enough.
options.B: Match the solid from the front view alone.
options.C: Having named the solid is what creates the three views.
options.D: Also treat any single corner sketch as enough under the same three-view rule.
